{{DisambigMsg|the [[Atlas Rises]] version of the Blaze Javelin|the current version|Blaze Javelin}}
The '''Blaze Javelin''' is a multi-tool component.

==Summary==
The '''Blaze Javelin''' is a component of the [[multi-tool]].

==Game description==
The Blaze Javelin delivers instantaneous damage on targets. 

Plasma charge process creates an ionised gas arc to propel projectiles at great speed. User will perceive destructive results simultaneous to the pull of the trigger.

==How to acquire==
* The [[blueprint]] for this technology is given to the player by [[Polo]].

==Additional notes==
* This is a long-range weapon; the game equivalent of a sniper rifle. It has almost infinite charge and no reload. However, it is a poor choice for close range combat due to a long delay between shots.
* The Blaze Javelin may be a reference to Fallout 3's [https://fallout.gamepedia.com/Firelance Fire Lance] alien blaster

==Release history==
*[[Pathfinder]] - added as a game component.
